AccessSite.description: A place where a resource is loaded by a request-controlled identifier.
AccessSite.title: AccessSite

ChallengeCheck.description: One acquittal checklist item and what the search found (negative evidence).
ChallengeCheck.title: ChallengeCheck

Coverage.description: True-denominator progress: every question is counted somewhere.
Coverage.title: Coverage

Finding.description: A case file. The five evidence-contract fields are independent (PROJECT_PLAN §6).
Finding.title: Finding

Guard.description:
A check on the path to an access site, normalized to a canonical form.

``confirmed`` means the validator found executable code at ``span`` that
performs the check. A name or a comment never confirms a guard.
Guard.title: Guard

GuardKind.description: Canonical guard kinds from the ``guard_summary`` question (PROJECT_PLAN §3.1).
GuardKind.title: GuardKind

InputOrigin.description: Where a value comes from, as answered by the ``input_origin`` question.
InputOrigin.title: InputOrigin

PeerGroup.description: Consensus for one resource type, and the sites that deviate from it (§3.2).
PeerGroup.title: PeerGroup

PolicyAssertion.description:
An access rule, inferred from code or declared by a person.

Kept separate from code-derived facts, with author and provenance. A policy
never expands what the agent is allowed to do.
PolicyAssertion.title: PolicyAssertion

ProbeSpec.description: Data for a trusted transport; never a script or a model-written command.
ProbeSpec.title: ProbeSpec

ProbeStep.description:
One request made by the trusted runner and what came back.

``marker_present`` says whether the victim's marker (data or effect) was observed.
ProbeStep.title: ProbeStep

ProjectSnapshot.description: The exact files a review looked at, including uncommitted changes.
ProjectSnapshot.title: ProjectSnapshot

RunType.description: Live, replayed, and saved runs are always labeled differently (PROJECT_PLAN §15).
RunType.title: RunType

SourceSpan.description: A citation: lines in one file of one snapshot, with the hash of their text.
SourceSpan.title: SourceSpan

SuggestedChange.description: A minimal diff, applied only to a disposable copy for fix replay.
SuggestedChange.title: SuggestedChange

Toolchain.description: Everything needed to reproduce a run (design.md §12, Runs).
Toolchain.title: Toolchain

description:
Local report interchange, including records required to validate claims.

This composite is not a new persisted entity or API contract. Its schema
lives beside the report schemas, separately from the core entity registry.
title: ReportBundle
